Title: Azure Database for PostgreSQL – Hyperscale (Citus) is generally available in new regions

Body.Content:
Azure Database for PostgreSQL – Hyperscale (Citus) is now available in the Brazil South, France Central, and Switzerland North regions. With the addition of Azure Database for PostgreSQL – Hyperscale (Citus) to these regions, you can now distribute your Postgres database to horizontally scale queries across multiple machines using sharding. The query engine parallelizes incoming SQL queries across these servers for faster responses on large datasets. The query engine also serves applications that require greater scale and performance for typical workloads approaching or already exceeding 100 GB of data.

Learn more.
